name: LibriCSS: Continuous Speech Separation Dataset
description: LibriCSS is a dedicated continuous speech separation and multi-speaker speech recognition benchmark curated by Microsoft. Created by playing back concatenated LibriSpeech utterances in real acoustic meeting rooms with varying speaker overlap ratios (0% to 40%), it captures 10 hours of natural conversational audio using a 7-channel circular microphone array.
